old_problem: The generic suite neither proved which NVML library DCGM loaded nor attributed the named software check; service ordering was inverted and DeepSeek's level-1 request contradicted the source level 4.
disposition_reason: NVIDIA defines the NVML library software check and `DCGM_FR_CANNOT_OPEN_LIB`; level 4 includes the level-1 software checks. Runtime library resolution and entities can be safely parameterized without removing the extended suite.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row353 all 18 XLSX columns and history2949.
Applied NVIDIA DCGM software-check and cumulative-suite documentation.
No library, service, persistence or diagnostic state changed.

test_case.test_name: DCGM level-4 NVML library loading and API-path validation
test_case.purpose: Prove DCGM resolves the approved NVML library for every selected GPU and that the named software check plus all applicable level-4 tests complete without hidden skip or API error.
required_package: Isolation window and monitored abort limits
test_case.test_command: Preserve logs and capture driver/NVML linkage and device enumeration; establish approved DCGM service state, change persistence only if authorized, run the full untruncated level-4 suite once, extract the NVML software-check result and every test/skip, then restore baseline states.
test_case.expected_result: The intended NVML library loads, enumerates every selected GPU, the NVML software check reports PASS with no cannot-open-library/API error, and each expected level-4 test passes without unexplained skip.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires actual library identity plus the named NVML result and complete suite accounting; device enumeration, exit 0, level 1 alone or a log tail is insufficient.
safety_gate: Approved extended diagnostic and persistence/service changes
Drain selected GPUs and retain OOB access
No library-path mutation during the test
Monitor thermal/power/XID/AER/host health; stop without retry
expected_evidence: Driver/NVML/DCGM versions and resolved library path
NVML check status/error code and skip ledger
test_case.recovery: Abort the run on safety fault, restore the recorded service/persistence state, verify NVML enumeration and GPU health, and retain incomplete results without automatic rerun.
